source.publication: Instructions for 2025 PIT-ADJ; 2025 PIT-1 Personal Income Tax Return Instructions; 2025 Tax Rate Table (Tax Look Up Table)
source.section: PIT-ADJ instructions PDF page 4, line 13; PDF page 5, Table 1; PIT-ADJ instructions PDF page 1, line 1; PDF page 2, line 7; Form PIT-1 lines 9 to 18 and 22; instructions PDF page 25, line 12; PIT-1 instructions PDF page 25, line 14; PDF page 26, Low- and Middle-Income Tax Exemption Worksheet lines 1 to 8; PDF page 22, line 5; Tax Rate Table PDF pages 1 to 6, rows; PDF page 7 (T-7), over 100,000

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = private pension (person 0) 18,000.00 = 18,000.00. Federal taxable income = 18,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 additional for age 65 or older = 250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; Form PIT-1 takes only the federal line 12 amount, and no line for what the federal return subtracts after line 12). Form PIT-1, single. Line 9 federal AGI 18,000.00. Line 10 0.00 (standard deduction taken). Line 11 additions, PIT-ADJ line 1 (all state and municipal bond interest left out of federal AGI): other states' bond interest 20,000.00 = 20,000.00. Line 12 federal standard deduction 17,750.00. Line 13 dependents 0.00. Line 14 low- and middle-income worksheet: line 1 18,000.00; line 2 20,000.00; line 3 0.00; line 4 0.15; line 5 0.00; line 6 2,500.00 - 0.00 = 2,500.00; line 7 1 exemption(s); line 8 = 2,500.00. Line 15, PIT-ADJ: line 13 age 65 or older: Table 1 (single) row for federal AGI 18,000.00 gives 8,000.00 x 1 qualifying = 8,000.00; PIT-ADJ line 28 total 8,000.00. Line 17 = 18,000.00 + 20,000.00 - 17,750.00 - 2,500.00 - 8,000.00 = 9,750.00. By the projection: state_agi = federal taxable income 250.00 + 20,000.00 = 20,250.00; less base deductions 10,500.00 gives 9,750.00. Line 18 tax, schedule as numbers: 1.5% x 5,500.00 = 82.5 + 3.2% x 4,250.00 = 136; total 218.5, to the cent 218.50. The table row over 9,700 to 9,800 gives 219; expected keeps the formula figure. Lines 19 to 21 0.00. Line 22 net New Mexico income tax 218.50. At Table 1's top amount a federal deduction of 17,750.00 leaves almost nothing, so other-state bond interest is added to make the exemption reach tax. AGI of exactly 18,000.00 is the last 8,000.00 row.
